jobs.name: xinye-clean-backdrop-v2
jobs.prompt:
Edit supplied side-view three-tier OUTDOOR Chinese town tower-defense environment into a CLEAN REUSABLE BACKGROUND PLATE. Preserve the rich painted style, daylight, cool blue-gray stone, ochre weathered wood, green Shu tent at top right, mountains and trees. Landscape 16:9, ideally 2048x1152.
The input is a visual environment reference. Repaint and remove ALL foreground walking platforms, supporting horizontal floor beams, rails, foreground stairs and staircase railings. These interactive foreground elements will be added as separate transparent sprites. Reconstruct the scenery behind every removed element fully. Do not leave silhouettes, holes in the image, checkerboards or blank patches.
Keep three distinct scenic zones: upper third OPEN AIR hillside military encampment and main ivory green-trim canvas tent at FAR RIGHT; middle third open town street background with distant tiled rooftops and shuttered market stalls; bottom third the OUTSIDE of the massive stone city wall with a dusty foreground road and distant smoky enemy camp far left. Absolutely not indoor rooms or enclosed stacked apartments.
Upper lane reference line y=31% and middle lane y=59% must now be EMPTY of any horizontal walkway, board, floor or railing across the foreground, so future trapdoors can genuinely open onto the scenery BELOW. Paint subdued CONTINUOUS scenic depth behind these two bands. The bottom road at y=87% may remain as plain rough earth.
On the right of middle zone y=42%-59%, keep a stone gate surround with a DARK OPEN INTERIOR, no wooden doors. On the top right tent, entrance is OPEN DARK CLOTH INTERIOR, no closed front curtains. Remove visible flags and flame tongues (separate overlays later). No characters, no deployed weapons, no UI, no words, no numbers, no lights painted over interactive openings.
This layer must be detailed and cohesive but quieter than the actors. High quality thick outline hand-painted game backdrop, preserve outdoor feeling and clear 3-lane geometry.
